reuse.why: Uses the shared getMonthWideActionCategories selection, getSheetValue on the existing sum-amount cell, monthUtils, batchMessages and setBudget, and is registered with the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapper as its siblings.

duplication.why: Repeats the per-action income/tracking-mode skip and the expense sign flip inline, as every sibling month-wide action already does, rather than sharing them.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to setZero and the average actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts with the others.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and its tests.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with neighbouring actions; the inline income-skip rule is one more copy to keep in sync if that rule changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getMonthWideActionCategories and writes through setBudget inside batchMessages.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income-skip guard and sign flip are written in the same visible form as in setZero/set3MonthAvg, not disguised.
